description: Given a valid IPv4 address, return a defanged version of that IP address. A defanged IP address replaces every period "." with "[.]".
intuition: This is the simplest possible string transformation - just replace every dot with '[.]'. A single string replace call does the job.
approach: Simply replace all occurrences of "." with "[.]" using string replacement.
explanation:
1. Use the built-in string replace method.
2. Replace every "." with "[.]".
3. Return the modified string.
hints: This is a straightforward string replacement.
Every dot gets wrapped in brackets.
